mapper.sql: i.id, i.run_id, i.partner_code, pt.name AS partner_name, i.url_type, i.item_key, i.partner_plan_code, i.plan_id, i.change_type, i.status, i.name, i.data_text, i.data_gb, i.qos_text, i.voice_text, i.sms_text, i.network, i.generation, i.price, i.discount_months, i.price_after_discount, i.detail_url, i.source_url, i.site_order, array_to_string(i.changed_fields, '|') AS changed_fields, array_to_string(i.warnings, '|') AS warnings, array_to_string(i.edited_fields, '|') AS edited_fields, i.value_hash, i.reviewer, i.reason, i.memo, i.collected_on, i.reviewed_at, i.approver, i.approved_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crawl_item i JOIN partner pt ON pt.code = i.partner_code WHERE TRUE ORDER BY pt.sort_order, i.url_type, i.site_order NULLS LAST, i.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM crawl_item i WHERE TRUE

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REVIEW_PENDING') AS pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REVIEW_PENDING' AND change_type = 'NEW') AS pending_new, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REVIEW_PENDING' AND change_type = 'CHANGED') AS pending_changed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED') AS requested, count(*) FILTER (WHERE change_type = 'UNCHANGED' AND collected_on = #{collectedOn}) AS unchanged, count(*) FILTER (WHERE change_type = 'ENDED' AND collected_on = #{collectedOn}) AS ended, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'EXCLUDED' AND collected_on = #{collectedOn}) AS excluded FROM crawl_item
SELECT FROM crawl_item i JOIN partner pt ON pt.code = i.partner_code WHERE i.id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.update: UPDATE crawl_item SET name = #{v.name}, data_text = #{v.dataText}, data_gb = #{v.dataGb}, qos_text = #{v.qosText}, voice_text = #{v.voiceText}, sms_text = #{v.smsText}, network = #{v.network}, generation = #{v.generation}, price = #{v.price}, discount_months = #{v.discountMonths}, price_after_discount = #{v.priceAfterDiscount}, edited_fields = #{editedFields,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'REVIEW_PENDING'

UPDATE crawl_item SET status = CASE WHEN change_type = 'ENDED' THEN 'AUTO_APPLIED' ELSE 'REVIEW_PENDING' END, -- 판매 재개 반려 = 종료 유지 approver = #{approver}, reason = #{reason}, updated_at = now() WHERE status = 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED' AND id IN #{id}
UPDATE crawl_item SET status = 'APPROVED', approver = #{approver}, approved_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED'

UPDATE crawl_item SET status = 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED', reviewer = #{reviewer}, reviewed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND change_type = 'ENDED' AND status = 'AUTO_APPLIED' AND url_type <> 'MONTHLY'
UPDATE crawl_item SET plan_id = #{planId}, change_type = 'CHANGED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND change_type = 'NEW' AND status = 'REVIEW_PENDING' AND url_type <> 'MONTHLY'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM crawl_item WHERE status = #{status}
